# cgartlab-search — unified search

Route a query to the best backend(s), call each via the transport your environment
supports, normalize the results, and answer the user with a cited Markdown summary.

## When to use

Any external-information need: web search, deep research, library/API docs, news, sports
news, Chinese knowledge. If the answer must come from the internet (not the user's local
files or your training knowledge), use this skill.

## Step 1 — route

Read `references/routing.md` for the full table (curl column vs DSH/web_fetch column).
Quick guide:

| Intent | backend(s) |
|---|---|
| general web / facts / "查一下" | **bing** (brave in curl harnesses) |
| 行情 / 价格 / 走势 (market data) | **bing** (keyword-rewritten query) → direct-fetch data site (routing.md market two-step) |
| library/framework/API docs | **context7** |
| dev Q&A / errors | **so** (+ hn) |
| codebase / tool finding | **github** |
| latest / hot news | **tencent** (热点榜) or **qqnews** (+ bing) |
| 中文新闻 / 中文全网 | **tencent** (新闻搜索) + **zhihu** (全网中文) |
| 足球 / 体育 news | **hupu** (+ bing, qqnews) |
| deep research / broad | **bing + context7 + hn** (add exa+brave with curl) |
| 知乎 / Chinese knowledge | **zhihu** (official Global Search API — indexes the whole web, strong on 中文) |

## Step 2 — call

Open `references/backends.md` and follow the recipe for each chosen backend. Transport:

- **Shell with network** (Claude Code, Codex, terminal) → use the **curl** recipes (all
  backends), or run `scripts/search.mjs <backends> "<query>" --limit 5` (Node 18+, zero
  deps, emits normalized JSON). `scripts/search.sh` is the curl+python variant (it probes
  `$PYTHON`/`python3`/`python`); prefer `search.mjs` wherever Node exists.
- **No shell network (DSH)** → use your harness's **WebFetch/web_fetch** tool on the GET
  URLs in `backends.md`. Check its host-reachability list first; skip unreachable hosts
  with an `errors` entry.

Keys only matter for brave/exa/tencent/zhihu: env vars (`BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY`, ...) or
`secrets.json` next to SKILL.md. Key-less backends need nothing.

## Step 3 — normalize + answer

Merge into the normalized shape (see `backends.md`), dedupe by URL, then write the answer:

```markdown
## Docs (Context7)
- **<title>** — <one-line>. [source](url)
  <key excerpt>

## Web / Q&A (bing / so / github / hn)
- **<title>** — <snippet>. [link](url)

## News (qqnews / hupu / bing)
- **<title>** (<date>, <source>) — [link](url)
```

If a backend errored or was unreachable, add one line, e.g. "Brave/Exa 在本环境不可达，已用
bing 替代" or "知乎未配置，已用 bing site:zhihu.com 替代". Never fabricate results for a
failed backend.

## Degradation

Missing keys, anti-bot 403s, and blocked hosts are normal — record in `errors` and
continue. Only if ALL chosen backends fail, say so plainly and suggest checking
keys / network / backend configuration.

## Backend status (verified 2026-10-20)

- **Live & key-less (curl + web_fetch)**: bing, context7, qqnews, hupu, so, github, hn.
- **curl-only (keyed)**: brave, exa — unreachable from DSH's sandboxed egress.
- **Live (keyed)**: `zhihu` (official OpenAPI global search, HTTP) and `tencent`

# cgartlab-search

A **harness-agnostic** unified search skill. One entry point routes a query to the best
backend(s) and returns normalized, source-attributed results that the model turns into a
cited summary. Works in any agent harness that can make HTTP calls (DSH, Claude Code,
Codex, opencode, ...), including restricted-egress environments via web_fetch.

## Backends

| Backend | Best for | Transport | Key |
|---|---|---|---|
| bing (cn.bing.com RSS) | general web, facts, query news | curl + web_fetch | none |
| context7 | library/framework/API docs | curl + web_fetch | none |
| qqnews (腾讯新闻热榜) | latest/hot Chinese news | curl + web_fetch | none |
| hupu (虎扑足球) | 足球/体育 news | curl + web_fetch | none |
| so (Stack Overflow) | dev Q&A / error fixes | curl + web_fetch | none |
| github | repo/tool discovery | curl + web_fetch | none |
| hn (Algolia) | tech community signal | curl + web_fetch | none |
| brave | general web / news (quality) | curl only (header auth) | BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY |
| exa | deep research / semantic | curl only (POST + auth) | EXA_API_KEY |
| tencent (official CLI) | 中文新闻搜索 + 热点榜 | local `tencent-news-cli` binary | owned by the CLI (`apikey-set`) |
| zhihu (official OpenAPI) | 中文全网 / 知乎讨论 | curl + web_fetch | ZHIHU_API_KEY |

## Requirements

- **Normal harness**: a shell with `curl` (macOS/Linux/Windows 10+) — all backends.
- **DSH / restricted egress**: the harness's `web_fetch` tool — all key-less backends.
  See `references/backends.md` for the verified host-reachability map.
- **`scripts/search.mjs`**: Node 18+ (zero dependencies, uses global `fetch`).
- **`scripts/search.sh`**: a working `python3` **or** `python` — the script probes both
  (plus `$PYTHON`) and verifies real output, because on Windows `python3` can be a
  Microsoft Store alias stub that exits 0 while printing nothing.
- **`tencent` backend**: the local `tencent-news-cli` binary (see `references/backends.md`).
  Nothing else needs any install.

## Install

Copy the `cgartlab-search/` folder into your harness's skill directory:

- DSH: `~/.dsh/skills/`
- Claude Code: `~/.claude/skills/` or project `.claude/skills/`
- Others: see your harness's skill docs.

## Keys

Key-less backends need nothing. For brave/exa/tencent/zhihu set env vars
(`BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY`, `EXA_API_KEY`, `TENCENT_NEWS_KEY`, `ZHIHU_API_KEY`) or place a
`secrets.json` next to SKILL.md (see `secrets.example.json`). `secrets.json` is gitignored.

## Usage

Ask in natural language — "查一下 ...", "搜搜最新足球比赛新闻", "最近有什么重大新闻",
"React 的 use() 怎么用", "全面调研 ...". The skill triggers and routes automatically.
Direct invocation: `node scripts/search.mjs <backends> "<query>" --limit 5`.

Before committing, run the local gate — it is the same checks as `.github/workflows/ci.yml`,
so it works even where Actions is unavailable:
`bash scripts/gate.sh` (add `--smoke` to actually hit every backend once).

## Status (verified 2026-10-23)

- **9 of 11 backends live**: bing, context7, qqnews, hupu, so, github, hn (key-less) plus
  zhihu (official OpenAPI) and tencent (official CLI) — all smoke-tested end to end.
- **brave / exa**: wired via curl but need keys (none configured here) and are unreachable

- Both entry points (`search.mjs`, `search.sh`) were verified per-backend on Windows;

## [0.1.1] - 2026-10-23

### Added

- **`zhihu` 后端从占位变为可用**（`scripts/search.mjs`）：接入知乎官方 OpenAPI **Global Search**（`GET https://developer.zhihu.com/api/v1/content/global_search`，Bearer + `X-Request-Timestamp`）。检索范围为**全网公开内容**而非仅 zhihu.com，对中文主题表现好。参数为 PascalCase（`Query` / `Count` / `Filter` / `SearchDB`），`Count` 服务端限制 1-20，适配器本地同样截断以保证 `--limit` 诚实；`--news` 映射为 `SearchDB=realtime`。`published` 取自 `EditTime`（**编辑时间**，不是发布时间），`score` 取自 `RankingScore`。
- **`tencent` 后端从占位变为可用**（`scripts/search.mjs`）：接入腾讯新闻官方 **`tencent-news-cli`**（Go 二进制，非 HTTP API）。`search <关键词>` 走关键词搜索，`hot` 走热点榜（**仅当没有关键词时**使用；`--news` 不改变检索方式），`--limit` 本地截断到 1-50。因 CLI **没有 `--json` / `--format`**（实测 v1.0.17），适配器解析其文本输出；标题行带 `N. ` 序号前缀而其余字段为缩进，这是解析的关键差异点。
- `references/backends.md` 为两个后端补齐完整规格：认证方式、参数表、返回字段、输出文本格式、失败分支，以及 Tencent 安装的**已知安装器 bug**（`setup.ps1` 经 `pwsh` 调用时 `checksums.txt` 被当作单个字符串，导致 `No matching checksum` 误报，需手动校验 SHA-256 安装）。

### Changed

- `SKILL.md`：`description` 去掉 “pending Tencent News/Zhihu”，路由表补 `tencent`（热点榜 / 中文新闻搜索）与 `zhihu`（中文全网）入口，Backend status 段改为 2026-10-20 实测结果。
- **`tencent` 的密钥归属特殊**：key 由 `tencent-news-cli apikey-set` 持久化到 CLI 自身配置（Windows 为 `HKCU\Environment`），**不读 `secrets.json`**；`TENCENT_NEWS_KEY` / `tencent_news_key` 两个槽位保留但未使用，文档已注明。

### Fixed

- **`tencent` 二进制解析**：适配器原来只按裸命令名 `tencent-news-cli` 查找，而官方安装器把二进制放进 `~/.tencent-news-cli/bin/` 且**不修改 `PATH`**，已装好的机器上仍报 “not found”。现按 `TENCENT_NEWS_CLI_PATH` → `PATH` → 安装器默认目录 顺序解析，并在报错里列出已尝试的路径。
- **`tencent "关键词" --news` 丢弃关键词**：原逻辑把 `--news` 映射到 `hot`（热点榜），带关键词查询会返回与查询无关的头条。现仅当关键词为空时走 `hot`；`--news` 不再改变检索方式（该后端结果本就全是 `type=news`）。`references/backends.md` 的映射表同步更正。
- **`scripts/search.sh` 的 `tencent` / `zhihu` 仍是 “not configured” 占位**，与 `search.mjs` 不一致：按同一规格补齐实现（zhihu 走 `/content/global_search`，`Count` 本地截断 1-20；tencent 调官方 CLI，`--limit` 截断 1-50，含无关键词热点榜）。
- **`search.sh` 在本机全后端静默返回空**：脚本一律调 `python3`，而 Windows 上该命令可能是 Microsoft Store 别名存根（exit 0、无输出）。现探测 `$PYTHON` → `python3` → `python` 并**验证真实输出**（`print(1)` 必须等于 `1`），无可用解释器时输出明确错误。
- **`search.sh` 读不到 `secrets.json`**：路径以 MSYS 形式（`/d/...`）传给 Windows 原生 Python，触发 `FileNotFoundError`。改为经 **stdin** 传入 JSON；同时去掉 `shlex.quote`——它会把字面单引号塞进 `Authorization` 等请求头。
- **`zhihu` / `so` 的时间戳弃用告警**：`datetime.utcfromtimestamp` 在 Python 3.14 已弃用并往 stderr 打 `DeprecationWarning`；改为 timezone-aware，输出与 `search.mjs` 一致的 `...Z` 形式。

## SKILL.md Frontmatter

### description YAML 标量格式
- 失误：SKILL.md frontmatter 的 `description` 值含单引号（如 `don't`），未用单引号标量包裹，YAML 解析非法 → 规则：含撇号/特殊字符的 description 用单引号标量包裹，内部撇号双写（见 SKILL.md frontmatter）（commit 1b97f3f）

## 脚本与密钥

### secrets.json 解析路径
- 失误：`secrets.json` 解析路径未从技能根目录查找，在不同 harness 下找不到文件 → 规则：解析路径改为技能根优先（commit 1ad5fb8）

### key-less vs keyed 后端
- 失误：在受限 egress 环境（如 DSH）调用 brave/exa，这两个是 curl-only keyed 后端，WebFetch 不可达 → 规则：key-less 后端（bing/context7/qqnews/hupu/so/github/hn）走 WebFetch，keyed 后端（brave/exa）走 curl，不可达时降级用 bing 替代（见 SKILL.md「Backend status」）

### 失败后端不编造
- 失误：某后端不可达时编造结果替代 → 规则：不可达的后端在回复中加一行说明（如 "Brave/Exa 在本环境不可达，已用 bing 替代"），绝不编造（见 SKILL.md「Step 3」）

### python3 可能是空存根
- 失误：`scripts/search.sh` 直接用 `python3`，本机该命令是 Microsoft Store 别名存根，exit 0 且不输出，全部后端静默返回空 JSON → 规则：脚本必须探测解释器并验证真实输出（`"$cand" -c 'print(1)'` 等于 `1`），不能只看命令是否存在

### 原生工具不读 MSYS 路径
- 失误：把 `$(cd … && pwd)` 得到的 `/d/...` 路径当参数传给 Windows 原生 Python，抛 `FileNotFoundError` → 规则：给原生工具的数据一律走 stdin（或先 `cygpath -w`），不把 MSYS 路径用作参数

### 安装器不改 PATH
- 失误：`tencent` 适配器只解析裸命令名，而官方安装器把二进制放在 `~/.tencent-news-cli/bin/` 且不改 `PATH`，已装好的机器仍报 "not found" → 规则：外部 CLI 依赖按 `环境变量` → `PATH` → `安装器默认目录` 三级解析

### public 仓库不能调用 private 仓库的 reusable workflow
- 失误：`publish.yml` 用 `uses: cgartlab/cgartlab-skills/.github/workflows/publish-skill.yml@main` 复用发布逻辑，仓库转为 public 后 `gh workflow run publish.yml` 直接报 `workflow was not found`，registry 发布整条链路静默失效 → 规则：skill 仓库的发布逻辑内联在本仓库（`.github/actions/publish/action.yml`），不跨仓库引用 reusable workflow

- 失误：workflow 的缩进/键名错误只有推到 GitHub 才知道，一轮反馈几十秒起步 → 规则：`scripts/gate.sh` 的 [5/5] 解析 `.github/workflows/*.yml` 与 `.github/actions/*/action.yml`（composite step 必须显式写 `shell`），依赖 PyYAML，缺失时降级为 warn

# 发布流程（RELEASING）

> 本文只写**流程与判据**；规则细则留在单一事实源：版本门槛见立正 skill 的 `references/judgment-criteria.md`（多层门）与 `references/release-versioning.md`，变更记录格式见 `references/changelog-sections.md`，版本载体清单见 `references/version-file-inventory.md`。**本文不复述它们的规则**（复述出的副本正是历史上漂移的地方）。

## 一、版本策略

| 项 | 约定 |
|---|---|
| 当前阶段 | **未切 1.0**：版本保持 `0.x`；未发布变更记入 `CHANGELOG.md` 的 `[Unreleased]`；是否切版、切到几，由维护者决定 |
| 版本载体 | **唯一载体**：`SKILL.md` frontmatter 的 `metadata.version`（立正脚本识别为 `agent-skill` 生态；缺失会导致 `version_files=[]`、`consistent=null`） |
| 编号语义 | semver：`feat` → minor、`fix` → patch、破坏性变更 → major（`0.x` 期间 minor 可含破坏性变更，但必须在 CHANGELOG 写明） |
| tag 命名 | `v<version>`，与 `metadata.version` **逐字一致** |
| 日期字段 | `metadata.date` 用**真实**发布日期 |

## 二、发布前的三道闸

1. **本地预检（只读）**：用立正的黑盒脚本核对仓库状态与版本一致性，要求 `is_git=true`、工作区干净、`version_files` 含 `SKILL.md`、`consistent=true`：

   ```powershell
   pwsh -NoProfile -File $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\attention\scripts\git_state_snapshot.ps1 --repo .
   pwsh -NoProfile -File $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\attention\scripts\version_consistency_audit.ps1 --repo .
   ```

2. **内容闸**：`CHANGELOG.md` 的 `[Unreleased]` 内容完整且每条可溯源（追不到 diff 依据的条目写 `［待补充：…］`，**不得**用 commit message 措辞填充）。
3. **版本闸**：`metadata.version` 与拟打 tag 一致；**推送 tag / 开 PR 属远程不可逆动作，执行点需单独最终确认**。

## 三、切一次版的标准动作

1. 确认 `[Unreleased]` 完整且可溯源。
2. 定版本号（拿不准就问维护者；不编造、不擅自跳大版本）。
3. 一致 bump：`SKILL.md` → `metadata.version` / `metadata.date`；`CHANGELOG.md` 把 `[Unreleased]` 改名为 `## [x.y.z] - <真实日期>`，并在其上方新开一个空的 `## [Unreleased]`。
4. 跑闸门（`bash scripts/gate.sh --smoke`，它是 `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的等价实现 + 逐后端实跑；另跑 `evals/evals.json` 用例）。
5. 提交：`chore(release): x.y.z`。
6. 打本地 tag：`git tag -a v<x.y.z> -m "<摘要>"`；推送 tag 与开 PR 需单独确认。

## 四、本项目的发布边界

- **无 remote 时为纯本地仓库**：只做本地提交与本地 `git tag`，跳过推送与 PR（立正 `environment-and-prereqs.md`）。**不要说"连不上远程"**——没配远程就是没配。
- **首次发布例外（仅此一次）**：`0.1.0` 的导入与发布提交直接落在 `main` 上——新仓库在首个提交前不存在分支，无法走"先建分支"的常规路径。**此后每次发布变更都应走分支 + PR**，除非维护者当次另行裁定。
- **维护者 2026-10-23 裁定**：日常变更可直接提交 `main`（覆盖 `AGENTS.md` 的通用 PR 约定）。不可逆动作仍需单独确认：推送 tag、改写历史、变更仓库可见性。
- 受限出口环境下 `brave` / `exa` / `tencent` / `zhihu` 不可用属**预期状态**，不构成发布阻塞；`references/backends.md` 已记录可达性地图与降级规则。

## 五、发布自动化

| 文件 | 触发 | 职责 |
|---|---|---|
| `.github/workflows/release.yml` | push tag `v*` | 校验 tag == `metadata.version` → 门禁 → 从 CHANGELOG 抽本版小节建 Release → `needs:` 串起发布 |
| `.github/actions/publish/action.yml` | 被 release / publish 调用 | ClawHub 与 SkillHub 的打包与发布（逻辑唯一副本） |
| `.github/workflows/publish.yml` | 手动 dispatch | 只用于补发失败的发布、验证 token（`dry_run=true` 只打包） |

发布逻辑必须留在本仓库：public 仓库不能引用 private 仓库的 reusable workflow，跨仓库复用会让发布静默失效。`version` 由 `release.yml` 校验过的 `SKILL.md` 提供，publish 侧不再读 tag，避免两套版本号。

# Routing strategy — cgartlab-search

Pick backend(s) by the user's PRIMARY intent. Multi-select (comma-separated) for broad
fan-out. Two columns: the curl recipe (any shell-networked harness) and the web_fetch
recipe (DSH / restricted-egress environments).

| Intent / signal | curl harness | DSH (web_fetch) |
|---|---|---|
| general web, facts, fast answer | brave | **bing** |
| library/framework/API docs, "how do I use X" | context7 | **context7** |
| dev how-to / error fixes (Q&A) | brave, exa | **so** (+ hn) |
| find a codebase / tool / alternative | brave | **github** |
| deep research / best content / opinion | exa, brave | **bing** (multi-angle queries) + **hn** |
| latest / hot news (全站热点) | tencent*, brave --news | **qqnews** (+ bing) |
| query-specific news ("X 最新消息") | brave --news | **bing** (append 新闻/最新) |
| 足球 / 体育 news | brave --news | **hupu** (+ bing, qqnews) |
| Chinese knowledge / opinion (知乎上怎么看) | zhihu*, exa | **bing best-effort**: `site:zhihu.com` + compound query; **gate on topical relevance — if results collapse to generic definitions, report the fallback missed** (then exa/brave) |
| broad "全面调研 / 全面了解 X" | exa,brave,context7 | **bing,context7,hn** |

(* = endpoint/key still pending; degrade as noted below.)

Rules of thumb:
- Language does not decide intent — a Chinese question about a JS library still goes to
  context7, not zhihu.
- "最新/热榜/新闻" → news backends first; "查一下X" (lookup) → bing; docs intent → context7.
- When unsure between bing and a specialist: bing for generic, specialist (hupu/so/github/
  hn/qqnews) when the domain matches — specialist sources are fresher and better scoped.
- **Rewrite long time-phrase queries to keywords before bing** (verified: "过去一周黄金价格
  走势" returned dictionary entries for "过去" and zero gold results). Keep head nouns + one
  time keyword — "黄金 本周 走势", "黄金价格 最新 走势 国际金价"; drop filler time words.
- **Retry with the tight compound form when the spaced form misses** (verified: `昆明地震`
  → 10/10 on-topic quake reports; `昆明 地震 新闻` → zero quake hits, only generic city
  pages). Juxtapose place/event terms without spaces and drop generic suffixes
  (新闻/资讯/文章) — they dilute RSS relevance instead of sharpening it. When one form
  misses, the other is the immediate second attempt.
- **Numbers/data queries (行情/价格/销量/榜单) = two-step pattern**: (1) keyword-form bing
  query to locate data sites; (2) direct-fetch 1–2 site pages for the actual figures —
  portal pages usually LACK them (verified: `比亚迪 销量 最新` → BYD official/baike/stock
  portals, zero sales figures). Verified targets (2026-10-01): `www.cngold.org` (快讯流 +
  quote pages carry numbers in HTML), `www.huilvbiao.com/gold` (static brand/recycle tables
  — but its /silver page showed JS placeholders `--`). If step-2 returns placeholders/empty,
  the number is often already in the bing RSS description (verified: 现货白银 60.62 quote
  appeared in snippet) — use it or switch to a cngold quote page. JS-only bodies → prefer
  static-HTML sites.
- Fan-out only for genuinely broad research; otherwise single backend to save time/tokens.
- Unreachable/unconfigured backends: record in `errors`, continue. NEVER fabricate results
  for a failed backend — say plainly what was and wasn't reachable.
- Fault scope decides the response: ONE host failing → skip that backend, continue; EVERY
  host failing with the SAME error (esp. `resolves to a non-public IP address`, including
  known-stable context7.com) → environment-level DNS/proxy outage — stop, report it, tell
  the user to check proxy/DNS; churning through more backends proves nothing.
